title: Baghel Singh Sets Terms for Meeting the Emperor

blocks.text: A fresh episode opens as the Mughal court seeks a formal audience with the now-powerful Sikh chief. Another Episode About S. Baghel Singh begins by making clear that any approach to the Delhi's emperor will happen only on terms compatible with Khalsa dignity.
Baghel Singh's position is stated without softness. Without arms never does a Singh lift his foot, and never would the Singhs bow before a Muslim simply to satisfy imperial protocol.
This page therefore frames the coming audience as a negotiation of status before it becomes a ceremony. Delhi may summon him, but it cannot dictate the conditions under which a Khalsa chief appears.
